title: LORE Object Envelope
description: The three-part wrapper around every stored LORE kernel object. All objects share this structure regardless of kind. The 'content' body is kind-specific and validated by the per-kind schemas in SCHEMAS/<kind>.schema.json.

lore.description: Internal metadata written and managed by the workbench harness.

format_version.description: Envelope schema version. Always 1 for this generation.

kind.description: Concrete ontology kind. 'object' (abstract base) and 'thing'/'state' (projections) are never stored.

subkind.description: Optional refinement of kind: object-ref/alias, act/event, assertion/{evidence,evaluation,context-hint}.

id.description: Stable object identifier: kind:namespace:hex. Assigned at creation; never changes.

status.description: Lifecycle status from the closed enum in REGISTRIES/artifact-statuses.yaml.

previous_status.description: Status before the most recent transition (set by lore promote).

created_at.description: ISO 8601 UTC timestamp of object creation.

created_by.description: Actor id that created this object (e.g. 'agent:local', 'author:local').

content.description: Kind-specific payload. Validated by SCHEMAS/<kind>.schema.json. Populated by the creator; never altered by transport or promotion.

source_refs.description: Object ids or external URIs that this object was derived from or directly references.

derived_from.description: Transformation inputs (subset of source_refs) that produced this object's content.

content_sha256.description: SHA-256 hex digest of the canonical JSON serialisation of 'content' at creation time.

signature.description: Relative path to detached OpenPGP .asc signature (required for author-only statuses, see DECISION-AUTH-IDENTITY).

signer_fpr.description: OpenPGP fingerprint of the signing key; must match an entry in REGISTRIES/trusted-signers.txt.

author_preseeded.description: DEPRECATED migration flag. Replace with signature + signer_fpr before v1.0.0.

promoted_at.description: Timestamp of the most recent promotion (set by lore promote).

promoted_by.description: Actor id that performed the most recent promotion.

promotion_reason.description: Human-readable rationale for the most recent promotion.
